t: To decorate a Christmas Tree, you will first need to locate and cut down a Small Spruce Tree. These can be found growing in cold biomes, and sometimes their saplings will drop from Spruce Leaves.
要装饰圣诞树，你首先需寻找并砍伐一棵小型云杉树。它们生长于寒冷生物群系中，有时云杉树叶也会掉落云杉树苗。
Once you have your tree, you can leave it as is, or dye it with White Dye for a Snowy Christmas Tree. $(br2) Next, you'll need to craft a stand to place the Tree in:
获取树体后，你既可保持原样，也可用白色染料染色，制成雪景圣诞树。$(br2)接下来，你需要合成一个树架来安放圣诞树：

Now you're ready to decorate your tree. $(br2)Tree Decorations are: $(li)Lights $(li)Ornaments $(li)Sweet Berry Garland $(li)Tree Topper$(br2)There are two color choices for Tree Lights and Ornaments: White and Bright Colored, and you have your choice of either a Star or a Bow for a Tree Topper.
现在你已准备好装饰圣诞树了。$(br2)树饰包括：$(li)灯具 $(li)饰品 $(li)甜浆果花环 $(li)树顶装饰$(br2)树灯与饰品均提供白色与鲜艳彩色两种配色；树顶装饰则可任选星星或弓形。

The Trees have 3 sections, and each section can take one set of Tree Lights, one set of Ornaments, and one set of Sweet Berry Garland. Clicking on the Top section with a Topper will place the Topper Block above the tree. To remove/change the topper, interact with the topper itself.$(br2)To decorate, you place the item onto the desired Tree section. To remove an item you have placed on the tree, click on it with an empty hand.
圣诞树分为三段，每段均可安装一组树灯、一组饰品与一组甜浆果花环。在顶部区域点击树顶装饰，即可将其方块置于树顶上方。如需更换或移除树顶装饰，请直接与树顶装饰本身交互。$(br2)装饰时，将物品放置于目标树段即可；如需移除已放置的物品，请空手点击该物品。
